name: Vegetable Fried Rice
steps: Heat oil on high heat and fry onion for 1 minute.
Add carrot and capsicum; stir-fry 3 minutes.
Add cooked rice and soy sauce; toss 3-4 minutes.
Serve hot.

name: Egg Fried Rice
steps: Scramble eggs in hot oil and set aside.
Fry onion 2 minutes, add rice and soy sauce.
Fold in eggs and serve.

name: Paneer Bhurji
steps: Saute onion and chilli in oil until golden.
Add tomato and turmeric; cook until soft.
Add paneer, cook 3 minutes, and serve with roti.

name: Chana Masala
steps: Fry onion and ginger until brown.
Add tomato puree and garam masala; cook 8 minutes.
Add chickpeas and 1/2 cup water; simmer 15 minutes.

name: Chicken Curry
steps: Brown onions in oil, add ginger garlic paste.
Add tomato and curry powder; cook 8 minutes.
Add chicken and 1/2 cup water; simmer covered 20-25 minutes until cooked through (75 C inside).

name: Tomato Basil Pasta
steps: Boil pasta until al dente; reserve 1/2 cup pasta water.
Saute garlic in oil, add tomato and cook 8 minutes.
Toss pasta with sauce, a splash of pasta water, and basil.

name: Veg Omelette
steps: Whisk eggs with salt and vegetables.
Cook in buttered pan on medium heat 2-3 minutes per side.

name: Aloo Gobi
steps: Temper cumin in oil, add onion until soft.
Add potato, cauliflower, turmeric and salt.
Cover and cook on low 20 minutes, stirring occasionally.

name: Greek Salad
steps: Combine vegetables and olives in a bowl.
Top with feta, drizzle olive oil, season and serve.

name: Dal Tadka
steps: Pressure-cook washed lentils with turmeric and 3 cups water.
Heat ghee, fry cumin, garlic, onion, tomato.
Mix tadka into dal and simmer 5 minutes.

name: Masala Oats
steps: Saute onion, tomato, carrot in oil 3 minutes.
Add oats, turmeric, salt and 1.5 cups water; cook 5 minutes.

name: Grilled Chicken Salad
steps: Season chicken and grill 6-7 minutes per side until no longer pink inside.
Slice and place over vegetables; dress with lemon and olive oil.
